name: 45122 · Goshen, OH
findings: ZIP 45122 (Goshen) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45122 (Goshen) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45122 (Goshen) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 8% of all organizations here have no identified type.
